_comment: Game structure I verified in game, applied over web/facility-config.js when the page loads. facilities: counts (one per RV level, index 0 = RV 1), unlocks (facility level -> RV level) and outputCaps (how much finished output the facility holds before it stops, one per facility level, index 0 = level 1, null where unknown). levelUpCosts: by RV level, coins and items. moduleMaxLevels: by module id (ecological_module, kitchen_module, resource_detector, crafting_module), one max level per RV level. Empty objects mean no override. Examples: "facilities": { "Well": { "counts": [0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2], "unlocks": { "1": 4 }, "outputCaps": [260, 300, 340, 340, 340] } }, "levelUpCosts": { "8": { "coins": 180000, "items": [["rough_lumber", 500]] } }, "moduleMaxLevels": { "kitchen_module": [0, 1, 1, 2] }
